property_summary: For any non-zero contract Ether balance, a call to withdrawAll by the owner does not revert on the correct contract but reverts on the buggy contract (due to the empty body) when the subsequent sendMoney call is intentionally made to a contract that reverts; this manifests as a revert/no-revert difference observable via a try/catch.
change_summary: Replace the withdrawAll function body with an empty block so that no transfer occurs and the balance remains unchanged.
